title: The Sixteenth Group Chat
author: C. M. Ravensworth
blurb: Ada Montrose, a scholarship student at an academy with too many secrets, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. But when the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must save the tradition that made the town, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
